classified_differences.caller-referenced-id: UnitsDB data defect, not an engine identity defect. Both engines identify the binding 'cwt (US)' as NISTu230. UnitsDB (unitsdb c2c7d18 data/units.yaml) gives NISTu230 ('hundredweight (short, 100 lb)', symbol 'cwt (US)') a power-1, unprefixed root_units link to NISTu203 ('hundredweight (long, 112 lb)', symbol 'cwt (UK)') and no canonical_conversion, which asserts 1 cwt (US) = 1 cwt (UK) although the names give 100/112. unitsml-rs consults caller registrations along the root_units chain, so the NISTu203 entry applies (2 x 50 = 100 kg); unitsml-ruby consults the register only for the directly identified unit and finds no conversion path (ConversionError). Evidence and options: plurimath-org handoffs/F40-native/claude-20261111/decisions/cwt-us-root-units.json (recommended: UnitsDB data correction).
classified_differences.register-does-not-persist: native result wire carries canonical_magnitude and so converts eagerly; Ruby evaluates the bare variable without conversion. Boundary: host result wire.
classified_differences.register-refusal-too-many: ResourceLimitError is a host request limit; unitsml-ruby has no entry limit. Boundary: host request layer.
classified_differences.registered-affine-compound-refusal: native refuses degC*m eagerly; Ruby refuses only when the composite is converted ('affine unit inside a composite expression'). Boundary: eager vs lazy conversion.
classified_differences.registered-difference-minus-point-refusa: Ruby's existing Quantity#- (de4f5b9) accepts difference minus absolute point and types the result as a difference; native raises ScaleOperationError. Pre-existing Ruby semantics, not changed here; owner decision.
